# Google Scholar Blog

> > The official blog for Google Scholar, covering AI-powered academic search tools, research metrics, and PDF reading features for the scholarly community.

Google Scholar Blog publishes product announcements, feature updates, and research insights for academics and researchers. The blog regularly releases annual Scholar Metrics evaluations and introduces new AI-powered tools like Scholar Labs and enhanced PDF Reader capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Google Scholar
- Scholar Labs
- Scholar PDF Reader
- Scholar Metrics
- AI-powered search
- Academic research
- Document summarization
- AI outlines
- PDF annotation
- Research tools
- Academic metrics
- Feature announcements
- AI features
- Reference following
- Public access

## AI-Powered Features

- [Scholar Labs: An AI Powered Scholar Search](https://scholar.googleblog.com/2025/11/scholar-labs-ai-powered-scholar-search.html): Announcement of Scholar Labs AI-powered academic search features
- [AI Outlines in Scholar PDF Reader: Skim Per-Section Bullets, Deep Read What You Need](https://scholar.googleblog.com/2024/11/ai-outlines-in-scholar-pdf-reader-skim.html): AI-powered document summarization feature for Scholar PDF Reader

## Scholar PDF Reader

- [Mark It Up! Highlight and Comment in Scholar PDF Reader](https://scholar.googleblog.com/2025/11/mark-it-up-highlight-and-comment-in.html): Scholar PDF Reader annotation and highlighting feature announcement
- [Supercharge Your PDF Reading: Follow References, Skim Outline, Jump to Figures](https://scholar.googleblog.com/2024/03/supercharge-your-pdf-reading-follow.html): Scholar PDF Reader navigation and reference-following feature update
